notes.title: Update: Copy-Paste Feature
notes.content: Players can now copy polls and create them by pasting them into Twitch chat or directly into Stream Polls.

notes.title: COPY-PASTE FEATURE
notes.content:
[h3]Design your poll and [b]COPY IT!![/b][/h3]

[b]Select "Copy to Clipboard" when right-clicking on the poll! [/b]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479753/8c7904a355946394e6f93cead7e26cb94c196f08.png[/img]

        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479753/91bded10528335c6400735e1f8fb5973963bb6ec.png[/img]
[/td]

[h3][b]PASTE IT[/b] into Twitch chat![/h3]

It's also possible to use "Paste from Clipboard" directly in Stream Polls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479753/af04be8c3c6b47ab829d46841658579278a6b3e2.png[/img]


[h3]Let the magic happen![/h3]
